info.description:
These services are designed to allow our state and regional partner to access and update RCRAInfo data using REST API.
They are intended to replace the Exchange Network Web Services (SOAP) API as well as provide more granular access
to our data including lookups.
info.title: RCRA API Services

The date used to evaluate timeliness in regards to the standards outlined in the Enforcement Response Policy (ERP).  Note:  There can only be one Day Zero per evaluation. 

Guidance:

For SNY evaluations, Day Zero will be one of the following:
Evaluation Start Date of a non-followup evaluation by this agency;

 Latest Enforcement Date for an 810 or 820 action (if the agency is EPA then the date of an 810 enforcement action, if the agency is State then the date of an 820 enforcement action); or

Any valid date if the facility is a reclassified secondary violator.

For SNN evaluations, Day Zero must be null.

For follow-up evaluations, Day Zero will be the evaluation date of a non-followup evaluation by this agency.

For all other evaluations, Day Zero is equal to the Evaluation Start Date.

formerCitation.description: The citation from Federal or State regulations or statutes that specifies a violation or pending violation in sufficient detail to distinguish it from other violations intended to be addressed separately by other enforcement actions. They should be part of the inspection or evaluation report prepared by the person identifying the violation. New violations do not supersede resolved violations of the same regulation. actualRTCDate.description: Date that the agency determines that the handler demonstrated full physical compliance (the date compliance was verified). The handler will be considered to be out-of-full-physical-compliance until the Actual Returned to Compliance Date has been determined. Actual Return to Compliance Date does not necessarily mean that all enforcement actions are completed for this violation.  For violations of omission (such as not manifesting a load of waste), the Actual Return to Compliance Date is the date of a written commitment by the handler to comply in the future or the day of conviction in a criminal action. Penalty payment is not a condition of full physical compliance; however if non-payment is the only violation then the Actual Return to Compliance Date is the date that payment is received. Note: Because of the verification requirement, Actual Return to Compliance Date will rarely match Scheduled Compliance Date. Where orders address multiple violations, program implementers may not verify physical compliance for all violations until the handler indicates that all violations have been corrected.

[Value must be between 0 and 90 unless the Handler ID starts with AS then the value must be between -15 and 90]  Note:  Valid latitude example: 69.288268

longitude.description: Longitude of the site location expressed in GPS (Global Positioning System) format. The user should provide the decimal degrees value representing the degrees, minutes, and seconds.  [Value must be between -180 and -60 unless the Handler ID starts with AK, AS, GU, MP, TT, XI, or XJ then the value must be between -180 and 180]  Note: Valid longitude example: -147.650167

standardized.description: Indicates that the location address was standardized using the standardization candidates provided.  Note:  This only applies to addresses entered via the user interface (i.e., myRCRAid, the Biennial Report RCRAInfo Industry Application, or Handler module).  [Y - Yes; N - No; null - No]

HandlerSourceWashingtonAddendum.description: Addendum to the handler source for Washington specific information.

HandlerSourceWashingtonAddendumRecycling.description: Washington specific recycling addendum information for handlers.

federalWasteCodes.description: Federal codes corresponding to the hazardous waste generated by a site.  These codes are listed in 40 CFR Part 261, Subparts C and D, or are assigned by States for wastes that are either: 1) regulated and defined as hazardous by the State but are not regulated as RCRA hazardous waste, or 2) State equivalent waste codes for RCRA regulated hazardous wastes.

stateWasteCodes.description: State codes corresponding to the hazardous waste generated by a site.  These codes are listed in 40 CFR Part 261, Subparts C and D, or are assigned by States for wastes that are either: 1) regulated and defined as hazardous by the State but are not regulated as RCRA hazardous waste, or 2) State equivalent waste codes for RCRA regulated hazardous wastes.

furnaceExemption.description: Indicates that the site qualifies for the smelting, melting, and refining furnace exemption. Refer to 40 CFR 266.100(d), 266.100(g), and 266.100(h) for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

mixedWasteGenerator.description: Indicates whether the site is a generator or TSDF that handlers waste mixed with nuclear source, special nuclear, or by-product material subject to the Atomic Energy Act (AEA), RCRA Section 1004(41), 42 U.S.C. 6903. [For Sources I,R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]  Note:  Beginning on August 21, 2019, this data element is no longer being collected.

onsiteBurnerExemption.description: Indicates whether the site qualifies for the small quantity on-site burner exemption.  Refer to 40 CFR 266.108 for additional information.  [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

receivesOffSite.description: Indicates that the handler, whether public or private, currently accepts hazardous waste from another site (i.e., a site identified by a different EPA identification number). [For Sources with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

recognizedTraderExporter.description: Indicates if the site is domiciled in the United States and arranges and/or facilitates the export of wastes destined for recovery or disposal operations, either by purchasing from and subsequently selling to the United States and foreign facilities, or by acting under arrangements with a United States waste facility to arrange for the export of the wastes. Refer to 40 CFR 260.10 for additional information. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 12/20/2016, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

recognizedTraderImporter.description: Indicates if the site is domiciled in the United States and arranges and/or facilitates the import of wastes destined for recovery or disposal operations, either by purchasing from and subsequently selling to the United States and foreign facilities, or by acting under arrangements with a United States waste facility to arrange for the import of the wastes. Refer to 40 CFR 260.10 for additional information. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 12/20/2016, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

recyclerActivity.description: Indicates whether the site is engaged in the recycling of hazardous waste received from off-site through activities such as use or reuse as ingredients in industrial processes to make product provided that the materials are not being reclaimed, used, or reused as effective substitutes for commercial products, returned to the original process from which they are generated without first being reclaimed.  Refer to 40 CFR 261.6 for additional information.  [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

recyclerActivityNonStorage.description: Indicates whether the site recycles regulated hazardous wastes received from off-site without storage prior to recycling. Refer to 40 CFR 261.6 for additional information. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 6/1/2017, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

shortTermGenerator.description: Indicates whether the site's generator status is determined from a short-term or one-time event and not from on-going processes.  [For Sources I,R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

shortTermGeneratorNotes.description: Explanation of the short-term event that caused this site to become a generator. Note:  These notes may be released to the public.

slabExporter.description: Indicates if the site is an exporter of spent lead acid batteries (SLAB). Refer to 40 CFR 266 Subpart G and 40 CFR 266.80(a)(6), (8)-(10) for additional information.  [For records with a Receive Date prior to 12/20/2016, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

slabImporter.description: Indicates if the site is an importer of spent lead acid batteries (SLAB). Refer to 40 CFR 266 Subpart G and 40 CFR 266.80(a)(6), (8)-(10) for additional information. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 12/20/2016, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

subPartKCollege.description: Indicates if the site is managing laboratory hazardous waste under 40 CFR 262 Subpart K as an eligible college or university.

subPartKHospital.description: Indicates if the site is managing laboratory hazardous waste under 40 CFR 262 Subpart K as an eligible teaching hospital.

subPartKNonprofit.description: Indicates if the site is managing laboratory hazardous waste under 40 CFR 262 Subpart K as an eligible non-profit research institute.

subPartKWithdrawal.description: Indicates if the site is withdrawing from managing laboratory hazardous waste under 40 CFR 262 Subpart K.

subPartPHealthCare.description: Indicates that the site is managing hazardous waste pharmaceuticals under 40 CFR 266 Subpart P as a healthcare facility. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 8/21/2019, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

subPartPReverseDistributor.description: Indicates that the site is managing hazardous waste pharmaceuticals under 40 CFR 266 Subpart P as a reverse distributor. [For records with a Receive Date prior to 8/21/2019, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

subPartPWithdrawal.description: Indicates that the site has withdrawn from managing hazardous waste pharmaceuticals under 40 CFR 266 Subpart P as a healthcare facility or reverse distributor.

transferFacility.description: Indicates whether the site holds manifested hazardous waste at the site for a period of ten days or less while the waste is in transit. Refer to 40 CFR 263,12 for additional information. [For Sources with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

transporter.description: Indicates whether the site is engaged in the off-site transportation of hazardous waste by air, rail, highway, or water. Refer to 40 CFR 263 for additional information. [For Sources I,R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

tsd.description: Indicates whether the site is engaged in the treatment, storage, or disposal of hazardous waste which requires a RCRA hazardous waste permit.  Refer to 40 CFR 264, 265, 266, and 270 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

undergroundInjectionControl.description: Indicates whether the site is engaged in the management of hazardous wastes by subsurface emplacement of fluids through a bored, drilled, or driven well, or a dug well where the depth of the dug well is greater than its largest surface dimension.  Refer to 40 CFR 148 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

universalWasteDestinationFacility.description: Indicates whether the site treats, disposes of, or recycles universal wastes on-site. Refer to 40 CFR 261.9 and 40 CFR 273 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usImporter.description: Indicates whether the site is engaged in importing hazardous waste into the United States from a foreign country. Importers are required to obtain an EPA identification number prior to engaging in import activities. Refer to 40 CFR 262.10(e) and 40 CFR 262.84 for additional information. [For Sources I,R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilBurner.description: Indicates whether the site burns off-specification used oil for energy recovery in devices or processes such as: 1) Industrial furnaces, boilers for sites engaged in manufacturing processes, 2) Boilers for the production of electric power, steam heater or cooled air or other gases or fluids for sale, 3) Used oil space heaters provided that the used oil originates from the owner/operator or from do-it-yourself used oil generation, or 4) Hazardous waste incineration. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilMarketBurner.description: Indicates whether the site directs shipments of off-specification used oil from the site to used oil burners.  Refer to 40 CFR 279.70-75 for additional information. [For Sources I,R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilProcessor.description: Indicates whether the site processes used oil. Processing means chemical or physical operations that are designed to produce or make amenable for the production of fuels, oils, lubricants, or other oil-derived products through activities such as blending, filtration, separation, and distillation.  Refer to 40 CFR 279.50-59 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilRefiner.description: Indicates whether the site re-refines used oil. Refer to 40 CFR 279.50-59 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilSpecMarketer.description: Indicates whether the site first claims that used oil targeted for energy recovery meets used fuel oil specifications.  Refer to 40 CFR 279.11 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilTransferFacility.description: Indicates that the site owns or operates a used oil transfer facility. Refer to 40 CFR 279.40-47 for additional information. [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]

usedOilTransporter.description: Indicates whether the site transports or collects and transports used oil from more than one generator.  The transporter may aggregate loads for the purposes of transportation but may not process the oil with the exception of incidental processing, such as oil/water separation, that may occur during transportation. Refer to 40 CFR 279.40-47 for additional information.  [For Sources I, R, E, or T with a Receive Date prior to 4/1/2010, 'false' indicates No or Unknown]
